groups.activity: earn standing from mission affinity and Syndicate Medallions
groups.mode: solo, hit the cap then run the alerts
conditions: Daily standing cap is 16,000 plus 500 per Mastery Rank, shared across every faction syndicate and reset at 0:00 UTC. 21,500 a day at MR 11.

Hit the cap with mission affinity first, then solo the Syndicate Alerts (unlocked at rank 1) and turn in every medallion at the Steel Meridian enclave in a Relay. Alert rewards and medallions bypass the cap.
Rank-ups spend the standing in full and the cap blocks them when you are close, so bank medallions before the cap resets.
bonuses: Steel Meridian standing also raises Red Veil by 50%; Arbiters of Hexis and Cephalon Suda are neutral. New Loka and Perrin Sequence are opposed, so don't farm them together.
An XP booster doubles pledged standing. Radar mods (Primed Animal Instinct, Thief's Wit) and Limbo or Khora find medallions.

disclosures.title: why 365,000
disclosures.body: 240,000 standing carries the five rank-ups to General, since each rank-up spends the standing it needs. The 125,000-standing weapon purchase comes on top of that.
